description: Django models module defining data models for an e-commerce application, including UserProfile, Item, OrderItem, Order, Address, Payment, Coupon, and Refund, along with related methods and signal handlers.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: User profile extension linked to Django's user model, storing Stripe customer ID and purchasing preferences.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Represents a product with fields for title, price, category, label, description, and image, including URL generation methods.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Represents an item within an order, including quantity and methods for calculating prices and savings.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer's order, including related items, addresses, payment, coupon, and status flags, with a method to compute total cost.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Stores shipping or billing address details linked to a user, with country field and address type.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Stores payment transaction details including Stripe charge ID, user, amount, and timestamp.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Represents discount coupons with code and amount.

classes.name: Refund
classes.description: Stores refund requests linked to orders, including reason, email, and acceptance status.

methods.name: get_absolute_url
methods.description: Returns URL for product detail page.

methods.name: get_add_to_cart_url
methods.description: Returns URL to add item to cart.

methods.name: get_remove_from_cart_url
methods.description: Returns URL to remove item from cart.

methods.name: get_total_item_price
methods.description: Calculates total price for quantity of item.

methods.name: get_total_discount_item_price
methods.description: Calculates total discounted price for quantity of item.

methods.name: get_total
methods.description: Calculates total order cost, applying coupon discount if available.
